collection.title: Honda e 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Honda e 2020 Onwards model requires a 23" wiper blade for the drivers and a 18" blade for the  passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this model Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
